runtimeEvidenceBasis: Parent reported latest action has19records and final startup-audio-prepare-before at appearance+0.0077s, no after within30s. This audit did not access the active/completed device or reread those raw outputs.
conclusion: No obvious app-owned blocking wait is present on the preferred bundled preparation path. However, prepareCountdownAudio is synchronous on MainActor and performs actual synchronous file decoding plus AVFoundation engine construction/connection/preparation, so the call is not guaranteed cheap or nonblocking. The outer bracket alone does not localize the missing return or prove deadlock.

callChain.operation: Guard idle/failed, call beginCountdownPrewarm synchronously on MainActor.
Publish preparing, increment generation, countdownSchedulerIfNeeded; default factory may run for first call.
Create CountdownAudioScheduler/System backend; select bundled buffers before invoking prewarm.
For phrases1/2/3 sorted: bundle URL, AVAudioFile(forReading), processingFormat/length, PCM allocation, file.read into buffer, validate. Synchronous I/O/decoder framework boundary; no app timeout.
Bundled backend creates AVAudioEngine/AVAudioPlayerNode and attaches player in initialization.
prewarm resolves buffers/format, engine.connect(to mainMixerNode), engine.prepare; completion invoked synchronously for bundled path.
Completion immediately updates ready/failed via MainActor.assumeIsolated if on main; otherwise enqueues Task. No semaphore to wait for callback.

waitAndSharedStateFindings.bundledPath: No DispatchSemaphore/group wait, dispatch sync, lock acquisition, blocking sleep, busy wait, retry loop, or explicit run-loop drain in inspected preferred bundled call chain. Synchronous resource decoding is genuine work, not an asynchronous preload.
waitAndSharedStateFindings.schedulerLock: CountdownAudioScheduler NSLock protects schedule admission and stop (lines280–302), not prewarm itself. These are not normally entered by the initial Root prepare call.
waitAndSharedStateFindings.fallbackLock: Apple speech fallback uses NSLock via withStateLock at823; lock can contend in principle. Inspected critical sections contain state/dictionary manipulation and occasional logger calls, not synchronous dispatch, await, speech write, completion invocation or engine.prepare. No source-evidenced nested acquisition cycle found.
waitAndSharedStateFindings.fallbackWaitCase: preparePlaybackIfBuffersResolved Resolution.wait simply returns; missing speech buffers can leave preparation asynchronously pending without holding the caller until they arrive.
waitAndSharedStateFindings.frameworkSharedInitialization: Per-coach lazy scheduler owns its backend/playback/engine. No app-global once/semaphore cache was found in this preparation chain. Framework engine/audio/speech services may have internal shared initialization; no such behavior or latency is established by these sources.
waitAndSharedStateFindings.coachInitializationBeforeCall: AVSpeechSynthesizer and AVAudioSession.sharedInstance are created by coach convenience init, before an existing coach reaches prepareCountdownAudio. Default prepare itself does not directly set audio-session category/active.
waitAndSharedStateFindings.reentrantCompletionCaveat: A pending request created by startCountdown can cause prewarm completion to synchronously call startPreparedCountdown, which configures/activates session and starts playback. Root requestCountdownStart explicitly invokes prepare first and only later startCountdown; do not automatically attribute setActive/engine.start to this initial prepare bracket.

fallbackFrameworkBoundaries: If bundle loading/validation fails, AppleCountdownAudioSchedulingBackend initializes synthesizer/playback and calls render for3/2/1 synchronously.

render constructs utterance, enumerates installed speech voices, sets voice and invokes synthesizer.write. Completion is callback driven; three empty-render retries are scheduled with main.asyncAfter, not an inline wait.
Eventual playback preparation still uses the same engine.connect/prepare. Whether bundled or fallback was selected in the failed run is not identified by the outer startup marker.

sourceReferences.meaning: MainActor coach; default factory constructs scheduler lazily; prepare starts prewarm; completion can finish synchronously when already on main thread.
Backend selection attempts all three bundled MP3 resources synchronously; URL lookup, AVAudioFile open/decode/read, PCM allocation/format/length validation; fallback only on nil result.
Default scheduler constructs selected backend; bundled playback engine/player initialization/attach and connect/prepare are synchronous framework calls before completion.

Speech fallback constructor renders three phrases; short NSLock sections guard data, callbacks and playback preparation occur outside state lock. Resolution.wait returns immediately, not a blocking wait.

Fallback voice enumeration; activation/start occur in startPreparedCountdown. Initial Root prepare path has no pending request; other startCountdown usage can reenter prepared scheduling from completion.
